trust_decision.summary: Which purchase parameters the client may supply to the Omnipay gateway is decided in CheckoutService::preparePurchaseParameters, which at the pinned commit array_merges the whole client-controlled additional_data over the server-computed params (amount, currency, returnUrl, cancelUrl, transactionId, description, email, name).

landing_point.why: The summary names checkout, the payment amount and the gateway; the one array_merge of params with additional_data sits right after the amount computation in CheckoutService.

fix_sites.module_kind: application service (checkout action), same module as the landing point

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Keys not present in $params (gateway credential/config keys such as apiKey, profileId, testMode) are 'not the amount' and look like gateway configuration rather than the reported amount override, so a solver can argue they are outside the report.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: additional_data must still carry legitimate client payment data to the gateway: a 'card' array for the Dummy gateway, 'cardToken' for Mollie, 'paymentToken' declared in the TS type; an over-broad fix that drops additional_data entirely breaks card/token checkout.

O6_input_shapes: exact top-level key matching a server param name (e.g. 'amount') — removed by an array_key_exists denylist built from $params keys (fix.diff:16-21)
keys only conditionally present in $params ('email', 'name') are protected only when the order has them (app/Actions/Shop/CheckoutService.php:237-243); otherwise the client value passes

O7_producer.where: config/omnipay.php:19-37 loaded by app/Factories/OmnipayFactory.php:51-60 (gateway->initialize($param)); these gateway parameters become request defaults inside Omnipay, outside $params

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Client additional_data keys that are gateway-level parameters (apiKey, profileId, testMode) are not in $params, so the published denylist lets them override the gateway's configured values on the purchase request.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Report is about the amount; these look like configuration, not price.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function; the values come from config/omnipay.php:19-37 via app/Factories/OmnipayFactory.php:60, and the merge semantics live in vendored omnipay/common (not in the tree)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Spelling variants of protected keys (e.g. 'Amount', 'transaction_id', 'return_url') that Omnipay's setter-name normalisation maps onto the same setters, bypassing the case-sensitive array_key_exists denylist.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Solver reproduces with 'amount' only and verifies through that key.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same function; differential lives in vendored omnipay/common Helper::initialize (not in the tree, version v3.5.1 per composer.lock:5571-5572)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: getOrderDetails could accept caller-supplied overrides (e.g. merged items/amount breakdown) like the Omnipay path does.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: PayPal path currently bypasses the merge (app/Actions/Shop/CheckoutService.php:220-222); a maintainer adding PayPal vault/token support would plausibly thread additional_data into it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: handlePaymentReturn could merge request query parameters into the session metadata passed to completePurchase.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Gateways such as Mollie return identifiers on the return URL; merging them over session metadata is a common shortcut, a second producer for the same gateway-parameter sink.

O9_family: mass assignment / client-controlled parameter override of server-computed payment fields (CWE-915/CWE-472)

O10_build.toolchain: composer (PHP 8.x), phpunit; npm only for frontend

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip keys of additional_data that already exist in $params (or flip the merge order), exactly the published denylist, leaving gateway-config keys and key-spelling variants open; the robust allowlist (card, cardToken, paymentToken) closes everything in one line.

out_of_scope_notes: handlePaymentReturn marks the order paid on gateway success without comparing the captured amount to order->amount_cents (app/Actions/Shop/CheckoutService.php:190-192, 163-168); a separate verify-on-return defence, not pursued.
unverified: vendor/ is absent from the tree; Omnipay behaviour (AbstractGateway::createRequest merging gateway parameters into request parameters, Helper::initialize case/snake_case setter normalisation, existence of setAmountInteger) is from knowledge of omnipay/common v3, not cited code. Both O8 routes and O7 depend on it.
Whether overriding apiKey/testMode on the purchase request has a practical payment impact per gateway (Dummy/Mollie/Stripe) was not checked.
present_in_latest unknown: no latest release given.
Fix test tests/Webshop/Checkout/PocAmountOverrideTest.php is absent at the pinned commit (checked), so regression_tests_in_pinned_commit does not apply.
Not flagged single_site because O8 lists routes, but both depend on unverified vendor behaviour; if they fail to hold, single_site applies.
